why: TechRadar [5] answers the exact question hands-on (enclosure + NVMe on an M4 Mac mini) and Macworld [3] covers it in part, with two more Macworld pages (a Satechi deal, a Ugreen dock review) circling it. But none compares the cheapest route with current prices across drives and enclosures; Hard Bargains and EveryMac do so partially without testing. A focused page with priced drive+enclosure combos and tested speeds could get in, but it competes with TechRadar and Macworld.
